name: fusion-jev
description: Grounded Fusion inspection and bounded Jev choices for coding chats

interface.shortDescription: Grounded code evidence with bounded Jev choices.
interface.longDescription: Try Fusion for repository inspection and source-linked evidence. Jev selects only among bounded prebuilt actions when needed. Codex keeps reasoning, edits, commands, web research and correctness decisions. The adapter launches the published fusion-jev MCP server, pinned to its version, through npx.
defaultPrompt: Use Fusion when output would be long or noisy or several files are involved: fusion_inspect batches known reads, searches and Git evidence; fusion_assist takes a bounded task; fusion_evidence expands receipts or imports attributed host research. Use native tools for a single small read; do not call Jev for obvious reads.

Codex owns reasoning, edits, command choice, permissions, research and correctness. Run tests, builds, lint, installs and log commands through fusion-jev run -- program argv... if installed globally, else npx -y fusion-jev@0.3.0 run -- program argv... (in PowerShell write '--'); use RTK/native tools when Fusion is unavailable or unsupported. Continue in Codex on escalation.
